name: @falcon/e2e
description: Conformance harness (design §13 item 3, plan.md §16 "4.4 Hardening & release gate"): a scripted 20-step session against a real local stack (server + daemon + a simulated session process) exercising every wire primitive — permissions, mode switching, adoption, reconnect. Run pre-release as a release gate; also runs in CI as an ordinary vitest suite.
